newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Thursday, supported by the yen's weaker tendency, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 2.0 yen per kg higher. Benchmark October was up 1.5 yen at 133.5 yen.

Prices edged up on short-covering, but the rise, especially in nearby months, lost steam in the afternoon session as private investors switched to selling on any price rebound, the traders said. "Uncertainty over the currency market capped the upside. Weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan also may dampen sentiment," one trader said.
